data.title: Strategy's $64 Billion Bitcoin Bet Just Went Underwater
data.description: Bitcoin fell below the $75,451 average Strategy has paid for its 849,327 coins, putting a $64 billion position about $780 million underwater. Here is what 1,000 shares actually own after the notes and preferred stock, what the MSCI decision on Wednesday and the quarter-end mark do to it, and the sell, hold or trim math for a retiree holding the stock.
data.author: Jeremy Phillips
